title: Configure Access VLANs
description: Create VLAN 20, name it ENGINEERING, and assign PC-A to it. Verify the access port.
scenario: Create VLAN 20, name it ENGINEERING, and assign PC-A to it. Verify the access port.

concepts.title: What is a VLAN?
concepts.body: A VLAN is a virtual broadcast domain. Devices in VLAN 10 cannot see broadcasts from VLAN 20, even on the same switch.

concepts.title: Creating a VLAN
concepts.body: Create a VLAN in global config, then give it a name. The name is documentation — it tells you what the VLAN is for.

concepts.title: Assigning Access Ports
concepts.body: An access port belongs to one VLAN. Use "switchport mode access" then "switchport access vlan 20" to place a port in VLAN 20.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface FastEthernet0/1
SW1(config-if)# switchport mode access
SW1(config-if)# switchport access vlan 20

concepts.title: Verifying VLANs
concepts.body: Always verify. "show vlan brief" shows every VLAN and which ports are assigned to it.
concepts.code:
SW1# show vlan brief
VLAN Name          Status  Ports
20   ENGINEERING   active  Fa0/1
